'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
* '''Username:''' Karrdeshark
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
